answer: An hostile operator running 146 aliases therefore needs 160 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in basalt, expire in copper, and jade lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 12 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 816 identities would post 3889 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
